objective: Account for all substantive dissertation results; successful replication is not required for every claim, but actual attempts, findings and limitations are.
provenance_rule: Original numerical/software claims and thesis-specific analytical reductions require verification. Inherited textbook facts used in a transparent argument are identified assumptions/background, not an unlimited new Lean project.

claims.necessary: General written rank/logical/distance derivation with explicit periodic-cell assumptions, checked core and independent finite implementation comparisons
claims.stop: Accept analytical verification if argument and checks agree; optional full rank-nullity/quantum Lean formalization is not a missing dissertation replication.

claims.necessary: Explicit even-periodic cellulation, commutation, rank/logicals and distance proof; disclose prose/figure/code Pauli conflicts; independently check incidence mapping
claims.stop: Do not rely solely on finite ranks. Accept rigorous written cellulation/homology and disjoint-cycle proof with independent geometry checks; no requirement to reprove standard torus homology in Lean.

claims.necessary: Binary conjugation/support checks plus unitary stabilizer dimension/phase argument
claims.stop: Standard unitary and trace-projector facts are inherited background, not new mandatory formalization.

claims.necessary: Restricted-chain kernel, ideal-majority finite probabilities, explicit tie/independence assumptions and asymptotic bound
claims.stop: Verify ideal50percent statement; do not silently upgrade to proven BP-OSD threshold. Source BP asymptotic expectation stays an assessed unresolved extrapolation.

claims.necessary: Remaining-axis point equations factor into2D toric layers; restricted loop-plane kernel and ideal-majority limit
claims.stop: Same ideal-versus-actual-decoder distinction; no infinite-size numerical campaign merely to claim an exact50percent threshold.

claims.necessary: Unique recovery on allowed first-axis support; independently examine whether actual regularized unrestricted decoder implies the stronger always-correct wording
claims.stop: Report restricted theorem and actual finite tests separately; counterexample would refute universal implementation wording, absence does not prove it.

claims.necessary: Written syndrome-consistent OSD proof, code-loop invariant audit, independent bounded exhaustive algebra checks; identify BP approximation and min-plus terminology
claims.stop: Do not require a general theorem of loopy BP convergence/optimality, which source does not establish. Reject missing consistency/finite-input assumptions rather than claiming unconditional correctness.

other_stopping_rules.numerical: Existing all74item attempts and rejected-fit diagnostics retained. Missing production inputs and model inadequacy are explicit limited/unresolved outcomes, not invitations to fit-window hunting.
other_stopping_rules.speedup: Mechanism checked; exact factor needs absent benchmark baseline/workload/hardware.
other_stopping_rules.GUI: Backend checked; original frontend blocked by denied dependency, no bypass.
other_stopping_rules.background_future: Inherited background and source future work stay explicitly separate from original experiments.
other_stopping_rules.publication: Bundle meaningful new coverage into reviewed main PDF, preserving all prior results and remote-byte verification. PR metadata write stays paused.
